About Mega Noob Sky Obby: 50 Stages

Dash, jump, and balance your way through a massive colorful sky parkour! In this 3D platformer adventure, your mission is to guide your Noob through 50 unique stages filled with moving obstacles, winding spirals, and giant balancing spheres. Touch the checkpoints along the path to save your progress, or use the special Skip Stage feature if you get stuck on a super hard level. Complete challenges to unlock the legendary Golden Noob Character and show off your skills. Play smoothly with perfect touch controls on mobile or responsive keyboard inputs on PC!

How to play

PC Controls WASD or Arrow Keys Move character Space Jump Mouse Rotate camera angle R Reset game progress Test shortcut Mobile Controls Left Side Joystick Move character Right Side Button Jump Swipe Right Side of Screen Rotate camera angle
